questions.stem: A 33-year-old man was taken to the emergency room by the police after neighbors complained about his behavior. His family informed the doctor that he had been diagnosed with bipolar disorder and was recently started on lithium. While in the emergency room, he became combative and punched a nurse in the mouth. What is the next step in the management of this patient?
